description: Second embedding-fronted fighter, a paradigm sibling of m2v-first with a different embedding-space strategy: Hierarchical-KNN (nearest-neighbour search over an embedding index, coarse-to-fine domain-then-intent routing) leads at high, Linha-Fina's trained statistical classifier backs it at medium.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: m2v-first tests a flat single-vector-similarity embedding front door; knn-first tests a structurally different embedding mechanism — nearest-neighbour retrieval over a (documented hierarchical: domain-then-intent) index, config-verified in ovos_hierarchical_knn_pipeline/__init__.py (conf_high/conf_medium/conf_low, index_dir, hf repo id default) rather than a single learned classifier boundary. Pairing it with Linha-Fina (not Padatious, already used by m2v-first) keeps the two embedding-fronted fighters from sharing a backup engine, so a head-to-head between them isolates the embedding-front difference rather than being confounded by which classifier backs each up. Both m2v (dense sentence embeddings) and hierarchical-knn (KNN retrieval over an embedding index) are 'embeddings' paradigm per ENGINE_REGISTRY import paths (ovos_m2v_pipeline / ovos_hierarchical_knn_pipeline), distinct from every trained-classifier or keyword-rule engine used elsewhere in the league.
